notes: COLD RUN 9062. The same brief as 9061, one release stack later, to answer TWO questions at once. (1) DOES THE SHOP READ AS A SHOP: Pixelcoat 0.45.0 gives delco_1997 the wood panelling and slatwall that 9061 drew blank on 21 surfaces; Zoo 0.99.0 puts seven shelves on a 2.70 m bay where six left bare plank; Zoo 0.98.0 adds posters, banners, ceiling hangers, aisle signs and printed playmats; DC 0.141.2 fills the wall to the ceiling and stands islands in the floor; LF 0.93.0 skins the stairs concrete where 9061 showed greybox yellow. (2) WHAT IT COSTS: the room's worst case is 25,008 triangles against 9061's 8,260, over a 24,000 ceiling that is NOT a frame cost -- it is cubicle_bank's per-species budget borrowed as a yardstick. This package is measured against 9061's at matched stations to get the first real frame figure this pipeline has ever had for room density.
